intro: Nefer doesn’t just sit in your space—it shapes it. With bold lines and quiet depth, it turns everyday moments into something more composed, more complete.

features.title: Made to centre your space
features.text: With its toughened glass top and bold form, Nefer naturally draws the eye—without stealing the spotlight.

features.title: A texture that tells a story
features.text: The stone-patterned body adds visual depth and a grounded, natural feel—bringing character to your space without overwhelming it. It’s style that speaks softly but stands out.

features.title: We keep your things within reach
features.text: Open shelf storage lets you keep everyday essentials close, while display corners add a styled touch.

features.title: Designed to hold what matters
features.text: Whether it’s a book, tray or décor piece, our design offers the perfect mix of surface and storage.

features.title: We let your décor speak
features.text: With understated tones and modern lines, our modern matte finish elevates the things you place on it, not just itself.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
